title: A bounded list on a segment
statement: A list of integers is located at index $a$ in a function from natural numbers to integers, with length $N$, absolute-value bound $U$, and upper limit $top$, if its length is $N$, its entries agree with the function on the consecutive indices starting at $a$, every entry has absolute value at most $U$, and $a+N\le top$.
hypotheses_covered: Every entry agrees with the function at the corresponding index starting at $a$.
Every list entry has absolute value at most $U$.
